author: Camemes
body:
Heyo,
Looking for a team to join.

Timezone: AEST (Aussie for dayzz) 
12,179 kills
17,928 deaths
0.68 KD
075 PvP KD
Experience: Been apart of other teams such as Proximity/Qrysis, I've led those teams in the past.
Preferable position: I can play any position moderately well. I don't really shine in 1 position but am decently well across all positions. I'll basically go wherever the leader tells me to.
Communication: I have Skype and Teamspeak plus Slack for communication, also got a microphone so you won't be reading my chat all day.
Activity: I am active daily but depending on scrim times, I may be less active during scrims and such. But I am active on Avicus daily. My moderator position requires me to.
Anything else: I can meme.

Cheers,
Cammy
